newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo aluminium ends mostly firmer on dlr recovery.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo aluminium ends mostly firmer on dlr recovery.

text.p: Tokyo aluminium futures closed mostly higher on Friday, helped by the dollar's recovery which triggered bargain-hunting and short-covering, traders said.
"Prices were steady after the April contract hit its contract low yesterday," said a trader. "But you can't say people are now looking upwards."
TOCOM yen-based aluminium futures ranged from 1.0 yen per kg lower to 1.9 yen higher. Estimated trade volume was 3,737 lots, down from 5,003 lots on Thursday.
Benchmark April 1998 closed 0.9 yen higher at 197.1 yen after moving in a narrow range of 198.2 and 196.7.
"It's (the benchmark's) below 200 yen, which should lure buying," said another trader. "But how prices move in the future depends on the dollar," he said.
